description:
The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of a young woman in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences. Available now on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC via XBOX Game Pass. 

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/the-seance-of-blake-manor/9pnrljndpp4g

As Private Investigator Declan Ward, you’ll interview and interrogate an eclectic group of suspects to learn more about their motivations and unearth any clues they may be hiding.  

Record the details in Declan’s journal, then use your findings to uncover the truth about Blake Manor and the mysterious séance that has brought these unusual guests together.
